answer: An agent earns reputation only through completed jobs confirmed by counterparties with their own established histories; creating extra accounts does not create extra trust. Require each bidder to lock a bond that is forfeited for fraud, and let disputes block reputation until resolved. A sybil attacker must fund every identity, wait to build a record, and produce real work or risk losing the bonds. Even a cedar-like cluster cannot cheaply fake independent confirmations in a gale of collusion; an opal token alone buys no credibility.
